divergence_notes.note: Schema enforces mutual exclusivity of molecule/formulation/evidence_refs payloads and bans chemistry-v2 keys nested inside the molecule payload; the Rust runtime enforces neither (it validates only the required payload object and a TOP-LEVEL chemistry-key gate). Phase-1: either tighten the runtime to reject co-occurring/nested payloads or relax the schema to match; today the front door is more PERMISSIVE than the published schema on this axis.
Runtime rejects non-finite/duplicate-key/oversize/over-deep/over-wide inputs the schema-over-permissive-parser accepts (corroborates schema-runtime-parity-v1).

G1_structural_parity_predicted_subset.note: For every PARITY-predicted case schema_verdict == runtime_verdict (both ACCEPT or both REJECT). ANY disagreement here REFUTES structural parity.

G2_positives_both_accept.note: Every real coating envelope (3 synthetic bases + on-disk-shaped variants) accepted by both oracles.

G3_lexical_runtime_reject_superset.note: Runtime REJECTS non-finite numbers and duplicate keys that CPython-parsed schema ACCEPTS.

G4_parse_layer_both_fail.note: Malformed bytes fail before schema validation under both oracles (schema N/A_PARSE, runtime REJECT).

G5_structural_schema_reject_superset.note: NEW: schema REJECTS candidate-type payload-exclusivity and nested-chemistry violations that the runtime ACCEPTS (schema-stricter direction).

G6_resource_cap_boundary_localization.note: For depth/width/size: schema accepts all; runtime accept->reject transition is monotone; parity holds below the cap and runtime is a reject-superset past it.

headline: Structural-core parity CORROBORATED at scale (128/128); equivalence BIDIRECTIONALLY REFUTED -- runtime reject-superset on lexical/resource (9 cases + 3 localized caps) AND schema reject-superset on structural exclusivity/nested-chemistry (15/15 cases).

hypothesis.interpretation: At scale the two deciders agree EXACTLY on the structural-core layer (128/128 PARITY-predicted cases: required-field presence, field JSON-type, candidate_type enum, payload-object binding, and the top-level chemistry-v2 gate). Equivalence FAILS in BOTH directions on the typed finite corpus: (a) the RUNTIME is a strict reject-superset on the LEXICAL/RESOURCE layer -- it refuses IEEE-754 non-finite numbers, duplicate keys, and inputs past the >8 MiB / >64-depth / >100000-width caps that a JSON-Schema validator over a permissive parser ACCEPTS; and (b) NEWLY, the SCHEMA is a strict reject-superset on the STRUCTURAL EXCLUSIVITY layer -- via allOf/if-then/not it forbids candidate-type payload co-occurrence and nested chemistry-v2 keys (15/15 cases) that the runtime ACCEPTS because the runtime only checks the required payload is an object plus a TOP-LEVEL chemistry gate. Neither decider subsumes the other; they are incomparable, not equivalent.
hypothesis.statement: runtime and JSON Schema accept and reject the same finite typed corpus

non_circularity: Two independently-authored deciders: Oracle A is the on-disk declarative JSON Schema enforced by jsonschema 4.26.0 over CPython json; Oracle B is the compiled Rust amphora-core contract runtime. Neither oracle was fitted to the other; per-case LAYER + relationship PREDICTION were declared in a third artifact (build_mutation_corpus.py) from the module semantics, never from either oracle's output.

oracle_A_declarative.parser: CPython stdlib json (permissive: accepts NaN/Infinity, last-key-wins on duplicate keys)
